unit.why: A single anecdote: on Purim night an old hasid enters the dancing tzaddik's meal and quarrels with him, and the tzaddik answers with ecstatic declarations of his faith and spiritual attainments.

stories.start_quote: ופ״א בפורים בלילה בעת סעודתו ושתיית יין
stories.end_quote: ודיבר עוד כמה דברים שאין בזכרוני עתה
stories.summary_en: At his Purim night feast, drinking and dancing, the tzaddik is confronted by an old hasid over his youthful words against the Seer of Lublin; he answers that he fears no one, being nullified in God, proclaims his 'clear faith' of the patriarchs in Yiddish, shouts Shema, and claims unequalled attainment of the upper worlds.
